_comment: Example only. Copy to config/resume.json (gitignored) and fill in your own. Follows the JSON Resume shape (jsonresume.org). This JSON is the single source of truth the tailoring step edits; it is rendered to PDF through a fixed template, so the AI never touches layout. Optional: a highlight may carry a 'group' (sub-heading), and 'additional' holds extra one-line items.
